_comment: School events for the classroom screen: games, dances, performances, picture day, spirit weeks, tutorial and club and library hours. Add your own to the empty "events" list below. Anything starting with an underscore is documentation and is never read, so the examples further down cannot end up on a screen. The district academic calendar is separate: no-school days, grading periods, and report card dates come from the CSV in this same folder, not from here.
_comment_events: Your events go here. Each one needs a "kind" and a "label", plus exactly ONE of three shapes: "date" for a single day, "start" and "end" for a span, or "weekdays" for something that repeats every week. An event with two shapes is ambiguous and gets skipped.
_comment_kinds: kind is one of: game, dance, assembly, performance, spirit, tutorial, club, library, other. Anything else is skipped.
_comment_optional: detail is a short second line, like "Home, 5:30pm". from and to are HH:MM on a 24-hour clock, so 1:05pm is 13:05. All three are optional.
_comment_weekdays: weekdays are numbers as in the bell schedule: 0 is Monday through 6 is Sunday. Add an optional "effective" range so a semester's tutorial schedule stops when the semester does.
